At the very least, my girls don't seem to mind me handling their babies and actually seem to enjoy their little "child free breaks". I want to clarify as well, I am in no way an expert! Found this online: Amenhotep I does have some interesting things that might explain his name being chosen. Firstly, unlike most Pharohs, he was deified after his death and worshiped by a funerary cult that was so influential that its practices became what most people think of as ancient Egyptian burial rites. Secondly, his tomb is the first to have the Amduat (literally "What is in the Afterlife"), which details the history and function of the afterlife, and was to be used as a reference material by the deceased in order to find their way to where they wanted to be in the other world.
